data: En plein milieu de la nuit, Léo réveille son meilleur pote, Raphaël. Sa voiture est en panne, à une heure de Paris. Hors de question pour Raphaël d’y aller… jusqu’à ce que la femme de sa vie le pousse hors du lit. Arrivé sur place, il découvre qu’il n’y a aucune panne mais du champagne, des amis et une fête improvisée… Léo a fait un test à l’amitié. Et si une amitié, une existence entière ne dépendait que de cette seule question : « Tu te serais levé, toi, pour aller dépanner un pote à 3h du matin ? » (In the middle of the night, Léo wakes up his best friend Raphaël. His car has broken down an hour away from Paris. No way is Raphaël going to pick him up...that is until the woman of his dreams kicks him out of bed. Once he gets to where Léo is waiting, he discovers there is no breakdown, although there is champagne, friends, and an improvised party... Léo has carried out a test of friendship. And what if a friendship, a whole lifetime depended on this single question: Would you have got up at 3 o'clock in the morning to go and help a friend?)

In the middle of the night, Léo wakes up his best friend Raphaël. His car has broken down an hour away from Paris. No way is Raphaël going to pick him up...that is until the woman of his dreams kicks him out of bed. Once he gets to where Léo is waiting, he discovers there is no breakdown, although there is champagne, friends, and an improvised party... Léo has carried out a test of friendship. And what if a friendship, a whole lifetime depended on this single question: Would you have got up at 3 o'clock in the morning to go and help a friend?
